subject: Proposed funding-window schedule and conditional Net45 terms
messages:
From: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@helionhealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: finance@helionhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Looking to tighten payment cadence — ask on Net terms and staggered invoices

Hi Rishi,

Quick context: Helion is coming out of a series of accrual adjustments and we need to tighten our working capital window for vendor payments. We currently have Net60 with Redwood but are evaluating moving to Net45 for the next 3 months while we stabilize collections.

What we'd like to propose for this quarter: 
- Move to Net45 on all invoices for May–July 2027.
- Split monthly billing into two tranches for larger invoices: 60% at invoice date / 40% 30 days later (to keep CAC aligned with revenue recognition).
- Hold a credit cap of $200,000 on outstanding balance with a 20% prepayment on onboarding/invoice restructuring.
- VAT: Helion will be billed to our EU subsidiary for EU spend — we need Redwood to split VAT routing where applicable.

Please see attached a short forecast (Helion-forecast-May2027.xlsx) so your team can estimate peak O/S. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a Net45 + tranche schedule and the proposed credit cap? If there are contract steps (DocuSign / SOW mod) we'll need to loop procurement.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Thorpe
VP Finance, Helion Health
emma.thorpe@helionhealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@helionhealth.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Looking to tighten payment cadence — ask on Net terms and staggered invoices

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. We can work with a conditional Net45 and a tranche model for the short window you described, but I want to align internally on the guardrails so there are no surprises for either party. High-level thoughts: 

- Conditional Net45: acceptable for 90 days provided the credit cap and deposit are in place.
- Tranche schedule: we can send invoices split 60/40 but this requires a small SOW amendment so our billing team can create matching invoice templates (I attached a brief outline: proposed-schedule-v1.pdf).
- Credit cap / deposit: we typically require a one-time deposit to reduce credit exposure; 20% deposit on projected monthly run-rate sounds reasonable.
- VAT routing: Olga (cc) will review entity mapping; we'll need a line in the SOW to indicate EU entity billing for VAT purposes.

Next steps I propose:
1) Camila will own the SOW amendment and DocuSign flow.
2) Olga will run a quick credit check and confirm the $200k cap / collateral needs.
3) I will provisionally approve this to be enacted once the deposit clears and DocuSign is signed.

Can we aim to have the SOW out by Friday and a sign-off by next Wednesday?

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Helion — short-term Net45 + tranche ask (HB-3742)

Folks — forwarding Emma's ask (below). Quick internal assessment and asks before we respond with the SOW: 

Summary: Helion asks for Net45 for 3 months (May–July), split invoices 60/40, $200k credit cap, 20% deposit at first tranche. VAT to be routed to their EU entity.

Risk/controls to confirm: 
- Credit exposure: $200k cap is borderline given projected peak O/S in the attached forecast. Olga: can you run the 30/60/90 days burn and confirm whether we need collateral beyond the deposit? I attached a small assessment template (credit-assessment-3742.csv).
- Billing change: Priyom, will engineering/billing accept the two-line invoice template? We need to make sure our reporting still matches usage metrics and per-route throttles.
- Legal/contracting: Camila, can you prepare an SOW addendum with the tranche language + VAT entity clause and include a clause for automatic reversion to Net60 if any invoice goes >30 days overdue during the trial?

If we can get deposit (+ cleared payment) and signed SOW, I'm comfortable approving Net45 for the trial window. Otherwise we keep Net60 with a prepayment requirement.

R — attaching Emma's original note for context.

On Sat, May 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@helionhealth.com> wrote:
> Quick context: Helion is coming out of a series of accrual adjustments and we need to tighten our working capital window for vendor payments...

Regards,
Rishi
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@helionhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Helion — SOW amendment and DocuSign link for Net45 trial

Hi Emma — thanks again for the heads-up and the forecast. We reviewed internally and can move forward on the conditional plan outlined below. See the attached SOW that describes the invoice cadence and credit guardrails (SOW-Invoice-Schedule-Helion.pdf). Key points: 

- Trial term: 2027-05-31 through 2027-07-31; invoicing will be Net45 for the trial period.
- Invoice cadence: invoices over $50k will be split 60% at invoice date / 40% due 30 days later. Smaller invoices remain single line.
- Credit cap: $200,000 outstanding limit.
- Deposit: one-time 20% deposit on the first tranche; funds must clear before the first invoice posts.
- VAT routing: Redwood will send EU-related invoices to Helion's EU legal entity — VAT registration number must be provided and will be included on invoice header.
- Reversion clause: If any invoice ages >30 days during the trial, Redwood reserves the right to revert the account to Net60 and require prepayment for subsequent invoices until balances are current.

Please review the SOW and sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/helion-hb3742-invoice-schedule. Once signed and deposit is received (wire or ACH), we'll update billing and push the invoice template live.

If you want to tweak the tranche thresholds or the reversion clause, we can discuss but firming this now will let us start the run immediately.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW-Invoice-Schedule-Helion.pdf
